section_summary: This section tracks Japanese merchant vessels through reports from consulates, embassies, naval sources, and the U.S. High Commissioner in the Philippines. Many reports concern voyages carrying Japanese evacuees or returning nationals; others record port calls, cargo, fuel sales, and proposed immunity for Japanese government requisitioned ships. Most movement reports are followed by copies prepared for the Navy.

subfiles.title: Naruto Maru passengers at Manzanillo
subfiles.about: Reports passengers traveling to Japan and a Japanese consul disembarking from Naruto Maru.
subfiles.summary: Lists passengers bound for Japan and says Consul Kasuo Hayashi disembarked at Manzanillo.

subfiles.title: Naruto Maru arrives at Manzanillo
subfiles.about: Reports Naruto Maru's arrival from Yokohama.
subfiles.summary: Naruto Maru arrived at Manzanillo on October 25.

subfiles.title: Azuma Maru at Callao
subfiles.about: Reports Azuma Maru's Callao stop between Iquique and Yokohama.
subfiles.summary: Azuma Maru arrived October 29 and sailed October 30.

subfiles.title: Azuma Maru Navy transmission
subfiles.about: Passes the Azuma Maru movement report to the Navy.
subfiles.summary: Records the ship's Callao arrival and departure.

subfiles.title: Immunity for requisitioned Japanese ships
subfiles.about: Requests drafting of a letter concerning immunity for three Japanese government requisitioned ships.
subfiles.summary: Acheson asks Hackworth to consult Assistant Attorney General Shea on wording that recognizes the ships' sovereign immunity before attachment.

subfiles.title: Conversation on repatriation and embassy fuel
subfiles.about: Records Ballantine's discussion with Iguchi about passengers, reentry permits, and heating fuel.
subfiles.summary: Ballantine urges Japan to ease Americans' departure on three requisitioned ships. Iguchi raises expired U.S. reentry permits for Japanese residents and receives a statement about heating fuel for U.S. offices in Tokyo and Yokohama.

subfiles.title: Cross-reference to another decimal file
subfiles.about: Notes transfer of a related item to another file.
subfiles.summary: Records a transfer to file 894.1115.

subfiles.title: Hukei arrives at Bangkok
subfiles.about: Reports Hukei's arrival from Chancha.
subfiles.summary: Hukei arrived at Bangkok on October 28.

subfiles.title: Hukei Navy transmission
subfiles.about: Passes the Hukei arrival report to the Navy.
subfiles.summary: Lists Hukei's October 28 Bangkok arrival.

subfiles.title: Rakuto departs Bangkok
subfiles.about: Reports Rakuto's departure for Swatow.
subfiles.summary: Rakuto left Bangkok on October 27.

subfiles.title: Rakuto Navy transmission
subfiles.about: Passes the Rakuto departure report to the Navy.
subfiles.summary: Lists Rakuto's departure for Swatow.

subfiles.title: Japanese ships at the Panama Canal
subfiles.about: Reports movements and expected calls of several Japanese ships near the Panama Canal.
subfiles.summary: Lists departures from Cristóbal, arrivals at Cristóbal and Balboa, and possible rendezvous arrangements.

subfiles.title: Tatuta Maru expected at San Francisco
subfiles.about: Reports Tatuta Maru's expected arrival time.
subfiles.summary: Tatuta Maru was expected at San Francisco at 5 a.m. Saturday.

subfiles.title: Departures from Rio
subfiles.about: Reports two vessel departures from Rio.
subfiles.summary: Records departures of Nana Maru and a second ship whose OCR name is unclear.

subfiles.title: Terukawa Maru at Callao
subfiles.about: Reports Terukawa Maru's appearance, oil, prospective cotton cargo, and discharged dyes.
subfiles.summary: The ship arrived painted in war colors; the report lists oil taken in Mexico and cargo at Callao and Pisco.

subfiles.title: Norfolk Maru diesel supply
subfiles.about: Reports a diesel delivery to Norfolk Maru.
subfiles.summary: Zorritos reportedly supplied 1,418 tons of diesel around October 10.

subfiles.title: Hie Maru carries Japanese nationals from Bombay
subfiles.about: Reports Hie Maru's departure for Kobe with 322 Japanese nationals.
subfiles.summary: Passengers came from India, Mombasa, and Persian Gulf ports; two Japanese consular officers were aboard.

subfiles.title: Hie Maru Navy transmission
subfiles.about: Passes the Bombay repatriation report to the Navy.
subfiles.summary: Repeats Hie Maru's passenger totals and route.

subfiles.title: Terukawa Maru at Valparaíso
subfiles.about: Reports Terukawa Maru's Chilean stop and planned route to Kobe.
subfiles.summary: The vessel arrived from Arica and sailed toward San Antonio, Peru, Manzanillo, and Kobe.

subfiles.title: Terukawa Maru Navy transmission
subfiles.about: Passes the Valparaíso movement report to the Navy.
subfiles.summary: Lists the ship's arrival, departure, and intended route.

subfiles.title: Hikawa at Vancouver
subfiles.about: Reports Hikawa's Vancouver call en route to Seattle.
subfiles.summary: Hikawa arrived from Yokohama and departed for Seattle the same day.

subfiles.title: Tukuba Maru leaves Shanghai
subfiles.about: Reports Tukuba Maru's departure toward Bangkok.
subfiles.summary: The ship sailed October 29 via Amoy, Swatow, and intermediate ports.

subfiles.title: Tukuba Maru Navy transmission
subfiles.about: Passes Tukuba Maru's route to the Navy.
subfiles.summary: Repeats the Shanghai departure and Bangkok destination.

subfiles.title: Lima Maru and Hie Maru voyages
subfiles.about: Answers an inquiry about two ships' departures and possible repatriation voyages.
subfiles.summary: Linnell gives Lima Maru's September route toward Calcutta and Hie Maru's departure for India and the Near East.

subfiles.title: Lima Maru and Hie Maru Navy transmission
subfiles.about: Passes the Yokohama response to the Navy.
subfiles.summary: Repeats the two ships' departure information.

subfiles.title: Philippine oil sales cover letter
subfiles.from: Claude A. Buss, U.S. High Commissioner's office
subfiles.about: Forwards four company reports of September sales to Japanese and French vessels.
subfiles.summary: Encloses four oil company letters.

subfiles.title: Standard-Vacuum September sales
subfiles.about: Reports fuel deliveries to French vessels and none to Japanese vessels.
subfiles.summary: Lists three French vessels supplied in September.

subfiles.title: Tide Water sales to Japanese fishermen
subfiles.about: Reports September diesel sales to Japanese fishing launches.
subfiles.summary: One customer with three launches bought 25.3 tons.

subfiles.title: Iloilo oil company report
subfiles.about: Reports no vessel deliveries and analyzes diesel use by a Zamboanga fish exporter.
subfiles.summary: Crawford says September fuel and lubricant deliveries to French or Japanese vessels were nil. Cebu figures suggest Sea Foods Corporation's regular diesel purchases matched its fish exports.

subfiles.title: Caltex September petroleum sales
subfiles.about: Lists September bunker fuel and lubricant sales to named ships.
subfiles.summary: Provides quantities and dates for six ships.

subfiles.title: Inquiry about Lima Maru and Hie Maru
subfiles.about: Requests departure and repatriation details for two ships.
subfiles.summary: Asks whether Lima Maru sailed on a repatriation mission and when Hie Maru departed.

subfiles.title: Taratibo arrives at Surabaya
subfiles.about: Reports Taratibo's arrival from Keelung.
subfiles.summary: Taratibo arrived at Surabaya November 3.

subfiles.title: Taratibo Navy transmission
subfiles.about: Passes the Taratibo arrival report to the Navy.
subfiles.summary: Records the November 3 Surabaya arrival.

subfiles.title: Bangkok departures for Japan
subfiles.about: Reports Nitii and Nansin departing Bangkok for Japan.
subfiles.summary: Nitii left October 29 and Nansin October 30.

subfiles.title: Bangkok departures Navy transmission
subfiles.about: Passes two Bangkok departure dates to the Navy.
subfiles.summary: Form records departures for Japan; ship names are faint.

subfiles.title: Naruto Maru at Callao
subfiles.about: Reports Naruto Maru's Callao stop between Manzanillo and Valparaíso.
subfiles.summary: The ship arrived November 3 and departed November 4.

subfiles.title: Naruto Maru Navy transmission
subfiles.about: Passes Naruto Maru's Callao movement to the Navy.
subfiles.summary: Records the Callao call and Valparaíso destination.

subfiles.title: Asama departs Yokohama
subfiles.about: Reports Asama's departure to collect Japanese nationals.
subfiles.summary: Asama sailed November 6 for Singapore and Manila.

subfiles.title: Asama Navy transmission
subfiles.about: Passes Asama's route and apparent purpose to the Navy.
subfiles.summary: Lists Singapore and Manila as destinations.

subfiles.title: Nissyo arrival and evacuation plan
subfiles.about: Reports Nissyo's arrival and a planned evacuation with Takahito.
subfiles.summary: An initially garbled port name accompanies a plan to evacuate 1,450 Japanese women and children.

subfiles.title: Initial Nissyo Navy transmission
subfiles.about: Passes the initial Nissyo report while flagging its uncertain port.
subfiles.summary: Notes that a corrected port identification will follow.

subfiles.title: Corrected Nissyo arrival report
subfiles.about: Corrects Nissyo's arrival port to Palembang.
subfiles.summary: Nissyo arrived from Moji; it and Takahito were to evacuate Japanese women and children.

subfiles.title: Corrected Nissyo Navy transmission
subfiles.about: Passes the corrected Palembang report to the Navy.
subfiles.summary: Corrects the arrival port and repeats the evacuation plan.

subfiles.title: Shinai Maru arrives at Shanghai
subfiles.about: Reports Shinai Maru's arrival, reportedly from Rangoon.
subfiles.summary: The ship arrived November 6.

subfiles.title: Shinai Maru Navy transmission
subfiles.about: Passes the Shinai Maru arrival report to the Navy.
subfiles.summary: Lists Rangoon as the previous port.

subfiles.title: Verification request for Shinai Maru
subfiles.about: Requests confirmation of Shinai Maru's previous port.
subfiles.summary: Asks whether Rangoon was correctly reported.

subfiles.title: Haiphong, Hòn Gai, and Saigon movements
subfiles.about: Reports early November Japanese ship arrivals and departures.
subfiles.summary: Lists Asahi San, Syoto, and Seikai movements.

subfiles.title: Indochina movements Navy transmission
subfiles.about: Passes the Haiphong, Hòn Gai, and Saigon report to the Navy.
subfiles.summary: Tabulates three ship movements and ports without movements.

subfiles.title: Asahi San arrives at Saigon
subfiles.about: Reports Asahi San's arrival from Haiphong.
subfiles.summary: No other arrivals or departures are reported.

subfiles.title: Asahi San Navy transmission
subfiles.about: Passes the Asahi San arrival report to the Navy.
subfiles.summary: Records arrival from Haiphong and no departures.

subfiles.title: Hie collects Japanese nationals at Rangoon
subfiles.about: Reports Hie's brief Rangoon call for returning Japanese nationals.
subfiles.summary: Hie arrived and departed November 9.

subfiles.title: Hie Navy transmission
subfiles.about: Passes the Rangoon repatriation report to the Navy.
subfiles.summary: Repeats Hie's November 9 call.

subfiles.title: Terukawa Maru cargo at Antofagasta
subfiles.about: Reports Terukawa Maru's movement and mineral cargo.
subfiles.summary: The ship loaded nitrate of soda, antimony, and wolfram ore before sailing toward Tocopilla and Peru.

subfiles.title: Terukawa Maru cargo Navy transmission
subfiles.about: Passes the Antofagasta cargo and route report to the Navy.
subfiles.summary: Repeats the departure and mineral quantities.

subfiles.title: Takahito evacuates passengers from Batavia
subfiles.about: Reports Takahito's departure for Kobe with Japanese evacuees.
subfiles.summary: About 1,500 passengers, mostly women and children, departed November 10.

subfiles.title: Takahito Navy transmission
subfiles.about: Passes the Takahito evacuation report to the Navy.
subfiles.summary: Repeats the passenger estimate and Kobe destination.

subfiles.title: Naruto Maru at Valparaíso
subfiles.about: Reports Naruto Maru's Chilean movements.
subfiles.summary: The ship arrived from Callao November 8 and left for San Antonio and northern Chilean ports.

subfiles.title: Naruto Maru Navy transmission
subfiles.about: Passes the Valparaíso movement report to the Navy.
subfiles.summary: Records the ship's arrival and departure.

subfiles.title: Asama arrives at Singapore
subfiles.about: Reports Asama's schedule and expected evacuee boarding.
subfiles.summary: Expected to take 432 Japanese evacuees and ten through passengers toward Manila.

subfiles.title: Asama Singapore Navy transmission
subfiles.about: Passes Asama's Singapore schedule to the Navy.
subfiles.summary: Repeats the expected passenger totals and Manila arrival.

subfiles.title: Takaoka Maru cancels Manzanillo call
subfiles.about: Reports Takaoka Maru's order to return to Japan.
subfiles.summary: The ship would skip its expected Manzanillo call.

subfiles.title: Takaoka Maru Navy transmission
subfiles.about: Passes the cancelled Manzanillo call to the Navy.
subfiles.summary: Repeats that Takaoka Maru was ordered toward Japan.

subfiles.title: Asama leaves Singapore
subfiles.about: Updates Asama's passenger count and departure for Manila.
subfiles.summary: Reports 436 Japanese evacuees, eight through passengers, and no cargo.

subfiles.title: Asama departure Navy transmission
subfiles.about: Passes Asama's updated Singapore departure report to the Navy.
subfiles.summary: Repeats passenger counts and Manila schedule.

subfiles.title: Huzisima and Hukei leave Bangkok
subfiles.about: Reports two departures for Japan.
subfiles.summary: Huzisima and Hukei left November 13.

subfiles.title: Bangkok departures Navy transmission
subfiles.about: Passes the two November 13 departures to the Navy.
subfiles.summary: Lists Huzisima and Hukei; flags are unspecified.

subfiles.title: Tatuta arrives at Yokohama
subfiles.about: Reports Tatuta's arrival from San Francisco and Honolulu.
subfiles.summary: Tatuta arrived November 13.

subfiles.title: Tatuta Navy transmission
subfiles.about: Passes Tatuta's arrival report to the Navy.
subfiles.summary: Lists San Francisco and Honolulu as previous ports.

subfiles.title: Hikawa arrives at Yokohama
subfiles.about: Reports Hikawa's arrival from Seattle and Vancouver.
subfiles.summary: Hikawa arrived November 18.

subfiles.title: Hikawa Navy transmission
subfiles.about: Passes Hikawa's arrival report to the Navy.
subfiles.summary: Lists Seattle and Vancouver as previous ports.

subfiles.title: Terukawa Maru leaves Callao
subfiles.about: Reports Terukawa Maru's direct sailing to Yokohama.
subfiles.summary: The ship arrived from Valparaíso November 20 and left November 21.

subfiles.title: Terukawa Maru Navy transmission
subfiles.about: Passes Terukawa Maru's Callao movement to the Navy.
subfiles.summary: Records the direct Yokohama destination.

subfiles.title: Huzi arrives at Batavia
subfiles.about: Reports Huzi's arrival to evacuate Japanese nationals.
subfiles.summary: Huzi, also identified as Fuji, arrived November 22.

subfiles.title: Huzi Navy transmission
subfiles.about: Passes Huzi's Batavia arrival report to the Navy.
subfiles.summary: Repeats its repatriation purpose.

subfiles.title: Indochina ship and warship movements
subfiles.about: Reports merchant ship movements and a cruiser and destroyer at Saigon.
subfiles.summary: Lists seven merchant vessel entries across Haiphong and Saigon, plus movements of two warships.

subfiles.title: Indochina movements Navy transmission
subfiles.about: Passes merchant and warship movements to the Navy.
subfiles.summary: Tabulates seven merchant vessel entries and notes cruiser and destroyer movements.

subfiles.title: Naruto Maru at Antofagasta
subfiles.about: Reports Naruto Maru's arrival from Caldera and departure for Tocopilla.
subfiles.summary: Notes a 1,280 ton cargo, mostly antimony and lead silver.
